Hui Hai.personality: Tiny, invisible, very strong keepers of the forest and its streams
Hui Hai.playsLike: Pebbles from nowhere: small, sudden damage to anyone who misbehaves

lore.creature: Hui Hai and Yă Hui Hai, the little forest folk
lore.from: Ba Na (Bahnar) folk belief, Central Highlands of Vietnam (Gia Lai, Kon Tum)
lore.title: The Hui Hai
lore.eyebrow: Ba Na folk belief · the Highland forest
facts: The Ba Na of Vietnam's Central Highlands tell of the Hui Hai, invisible people of miniature size.
The men are called Hui Hai and the women Yă Hui Hai.
They live in the forests and the streams.
They are very small, but very strong.
They throw stones at people who behave badly in the forest. Nobody sees who threw it.

cards.name: Pebble, the Littlest Hui Hai
cards.flavor: Nobody has ever seen her. Plenty of people have met her pebbles.

kitten.name: Pebble, the Littlest Hui Hai
kitten.text:
Exhaust: Deal 1 damage to an enemy unit.
Awaken: You have 7 or more Offerings.

bigCat.name: Pebble, Keeper of the Stream
bigCat.text: Exhaust: Deal 2 damage to an enemy unit.

cards.name: Hui Hai of the Stream
cards.flavor: A ripple where there is no fish. A splash where there is no stone.
cards.text: Hello: Deal 1 damage to an enemy unit.

cards.name: Yă Hui Hai, Lady of the Ferns
cards.flavor: Small enough to sleep in a fern. Strong enough to move the rock beside it.
cards.text: Guardian. Hello: Deal 2 damage to an enemy unit.

cards.name: A Pebble at Your Feet
cards.flavor: Behave badly in the forest, and a stone lands beside you. Nobody threw it.
cards.text: Ambush. Deal 2 damage to an enemy unit.
